scope: Only these original audit artifacts are safe for public distribution. This is an allowlist, not a directory-wide publication permission.
excluded_patterns: any sibling priority-family output or candidate/source archive
private_source_policy: Private source bodies and local text extractions remain under private_sources/ and are ignored by local .gitignore. Do not copy them into public artifacts. Public report contains original derivation, concise factual descriptions and source links.
